name: PageContentsPanel - Before Opting In
description: The state every user meets first: the scope picker defaulted to Open tabs, the Search page contents button, the off-by-default deep scan checkbox, and the note saying the button asks permission to read the sites you visit. The note is the point — this is the only warning before a browser permission dialog, and a control that summons one unannounced is a control people learn not to touch.
